title: The Kadence Memberships WordPress plugin before 4.0.6 does not check that the membership level submitted when renewing…
description: The Kadence Memberships WordPress plugin versions before 4.0.6 contain a vulnerability where the plugin does not verify that the membership level submitted during renewal matches the level being renewed. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to activate a paid membership without payment on sites that also offer a free membership level.
